rationale: Authoritative native NASA grids retain several-day changes in complete simultaneous visibility at a common absolute observer, so synthetic area averaging is not the sole source of the R-01B effect. Removing censoring changes the threshold interpretation; Product 104 and the two observer conventions expose further conditionality. The supported result is a reproducible response to terrain representation, not a certified true window or a universal mission failure.
caution: Duration differences are not correctness probabilities; registered-domain and complete physical-episode classifications remain separate
